title: feat(news): switch the daily, Sunday and monthly posts to posts.py and deliver.py
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The daily, Sunday and monthly news posts switch to `posts.py` for writing and `deliver.py` for delivery, replacing the old generators, senders, prompts and workflows. The schedule stays at 06:00 daily, 15:00 Monday–Saturday and 18:00 Sunday, with the same posts and channels. `deliver.py` takes over daily posts from 2026-10-12 and weekly posts from 2026-10-18; the first new 06:00 run is 2026-10-13. Posts are saved and pushed one at a time before the next is written. Delivery holds the Buffer, Discord and Reddit keys and runs even if writing fails; failure issues identify whether writing or delivery failed. Manual runs default to preview and keep their texts and pictures for comparison. The index rebuild follows News / Posts. Checks matched saved daily and weekly texts word for word, reproduced the old Buffer, Discord and Reddit requests for 18 saved posts, and rehearsed the save-and-push loop against a racing writer.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli wears a tiny editor’s visor and guides one stack of pixel post cards from a writing desk to a delivery tray beside a lime green (#ecf874) glowing CRT, with little code-flowers growing nearby. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic, in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic scene with soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes and a warm cream background.
